items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Well, Norman has always been fair to musicians, I have to say. Because without us, he never would have gotten started.

ctx.x: That beats some of the other...

Well, Norman has always been fair to musicians, I have to say. Because without us, he never would have gotten started. We used to do those things at Normandie Hall that you were talking... We used to do those for ten dollars or whatever he could afford at the time. If he didn't make any money, we didn't make any. But it was okay. We just liked to play. That's the first place I heard Phineas Newborn, when he was 17, at Normandie Hall.
